title: Payout Limits and Permitted Pay Types — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Tier Schedule
content:
Every tier of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service caps the size and number of payouts and lists the kinds of pay it may disburse. The figures are per tier and are read from the tier the service holds.

| Tier | Largest single disbursement (USD) | Largest instant payout to an external debit card (USD) | Most disbursed on one calendar day, Eastern Time (USD) | Most one worker may receive on one calendar day (USD) | Most one worker may receive in one calendar month (USD) | Payouts one worker may receive on one calendar day | Kinds of pay permitted | Payee must be a current worker |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 500 | 500 | 5000 | 500 | 2500 | 3 | tips; off-cycle wages | yes |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 1000 | 1000 | 15000 | 1000 | 5000 | 3 | tips; off-cycle wages; final pay; bonus | yes |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 2500 | 2500 | 50000 | 2500 | 10000 | 5 | tips; off-cycle wages; final pay; bonus | yes |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 5000 | 2500 | 150000 | 5000 | 20000 | 5 | tips; off-cycle wages; final pay; bonus; expense reimbursement | yes |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 5000 | 2500 | 500000 | 5000 | 25000 | 10 | tips; off-cycle wages; final pay; bonus; expense reimbursement | yes |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 10000 | 2500 | 1500000 | 10000 | 50000 | 10 | tips; off-cycle wages; final pay; bonus; expense reimbursement | yes |

## Definitions

- **Largest single disbursement** — largest single disbursement (USD).
- **Largest instant payout to an external debit card** — largest single instant disbursement to an external debit card (USD).
- **Most disbursed on one calendar day** — most the service may disburse on one calendar day, Eastern Time (USD).
- **Most one worker may receive on one calendar day / in one calendar month** — the per-worker day and month amounts (USD).
- **Payouts one worker may receive on one calendar day** — disbursements one worker may receive on one calendar day (count).
- **Kinds of pay permitted** — kinds of pay the service may disburse.
- **Payee must be a current worker** — whether every payee must be a worker on the employer's payroll file; it is yes on every tier.

## Points that follow from the table

- On Starter through Growth the largest instant payout to an external debit card equals the largest single disbursement; from Pro upward the instant external figure stays at 2500 while the largest single disbursement is higher.
- Final pay and bonus are first permitted on Core; expense reimbursement is first permitted on Pro.
